original_review.note: Reproduced in vitest at head: event turn_finished {stop:'interrupted'} then subagent {sid:'cx:a', op:'finished', status:'failed'} -> player.started == ['A sub-agent failed.']. controller.ts:423 only cancels the waiting burst; nothing remembers the Stop. Fixed in 34b2b4d (notices.interrupted(thread) marks live children).

Reproduced: a fresh SpeechController (a reloaded window) that never saw the 'stopping' progress record announces 'A sub-agent failed.' on the later finished/failed record; notices.ts asked-set (98-125) is built only from live bus records. 34b2b4d seeds it from the list route for per-child Stops; it documents that the main-Stop half remains a known gap.

Reproduced: a notice queued behind another chat's ~550-char reply began 27 s later with no expiry; the floor marks notice as note (floor.ts:70) so it is never collapsed and nothing drops it. Fixed in 34b2b4d (NOTICE_STALE_MS 30 s, queue.dropUnstarted).

entries.mechanism: An ending that arrives after a burst's 3 s window closed, while that burst is still waiting for the owner to stop talking (busy retry), is added to the old burst instead of opening a new window, so it inherits the old burst's 20 s busy give-up (b.due set at first close): a fresh ending can be dropped as 'stale' moments after it arrived, and because heard() already put its sid in `announced` it is never said. The same path makes the documented 'an ending after the window is a new sentence' false during a busy wait (it silently joins the earlier sentence).
entries.location: hud/src/lib/speech/notices.ts:162-173 (add: reuses any existing burst); hud/src/lib/speech/notices.ts:176-192 (close: due fixed at first close, BUSY_MAX_MS give-up at :185); docs/notes/voice-face.md:3019, 3035
entries.evidence: vitest probe at head on SubagentNotices with busy() -> true: heard done at t=0, advance NOTICE_WINDOW_MS+BUSY_MAX_MS-600 ms, heard failed for a new sid (waiting {done:1,failed:1}), advance 1 s, busy=false, advance 10 s: said == [] (the fresh failure is lost). Second probe: done at t=0, busy wait 8 s, second done, busy off: said == ['Two sub-agents finished.'] (one sentence, not two). Unchanged on origin/main (add/close identical).

entries.mechanism: An interrupted turn_finished drops a waiting notice only when the chat is read at that moment: the notices.cancel(thread) call sits inside the switch after the `if (!this.speaks(thread)) return` guard, while subagent endings are heard regardless of speaks(). A burst collected while the chat is muted / in no pane / this window not the speaker survives the owner's main Stop, and if the chat becomes read again before the 3 s window closes (unmute, open the pane, gain the speech lock) the pre-Stop ending is spoken, contrary to the brief's 'dropped by ... an interrupted turn'.
entries.location: hud/src/lib/speech/controller.ts:395-402 (subagent heard before the speaks guard; guard returns early); hud/src/lib/speech/controller.ts:423 (interrupted branch: notices.cancel only reached when speaks)
entries.evidence: vitest probe at head: setMuted({T}); subagent cl:a finished done; turn_finished {stop:'interrupted'}; setMuted({}); advance 5 s -> player.started == ['A sub-agent finished.']. prune() on unmute only leaves threads that are not read, so the burst is kept. Still so on origin/main (34b2b4d added notices.interrupted before the guard but left cancel inside it, controller.ts:452).

non_issues.claim: The plan says the notice names the child ('<name> finished'); saying only a count drops a required feature / violates D7.
non_issues.why_not: Deliberate and recorded: the bus record carries no name (jarvis/v2/subagents.py:224-236 bus() omits name/kind), the owner's rule is that a child's text is never read aloud, and the PR records the as-built deviation in docs/plans/2026-10-13-subagent-view.md:235 and docs/notes/voice-face.md (Sub-agent notices, 'The plan also allowed the child's name ... It is left out').

non_issues.claim: A child that ends with status 'stopped' (session ended, main Stop) is never announced, so the owner misses an ending.
non_issues.why_not: Required by the plan: docs/plans/2026-10-13-subagent-view.md:231 '`stopped` is silent (Q5)'.

non_issues.claim: A child the owner asked to stop that then finishes 'done' (the Stop came too late) is wrongly kept silent.
non_issues.why_not: Stated behaviour: the brief and notices.ts header (lines 21-23) say a child whose record said stop stopping|unconfirmed is silent 'however it then ends'; the owner pressed Stop on it, so no notice is the intended result. A CLI 'refused' (stop not taken) clears it (asked.delete on a live record without stopping/unconfirmed).

non_issues.claim: subagent records are processed before the speaks() check, so chats that are muted or not in a pane get notices / the window leaks state for unread chats.
non_issues.why_not: Intentional so an owner Stop heard while the chat is unread still silences that child's later end; whether to speak is checked again when the window closes (notices.ts close(): canSpeak, and deliver() re-checks speaks, controller.ts:505). Pinned by notices.test.ts:234 and noticesController.test.ts:120. (The narrow interrupted-turn gap is rb2, not this.)

non_issues.claim: notices.ts's SID regex may reject valid sub-agent ids (or accept ids the daemon would not).
non_issues.why_not: It is the daemon's own pattern: jarvis/v2/subagents.py:101 SID = (?:cl|cx):[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}, enforced by valid_sid (:118-119) before anything reaches the bus.

non_issues.claim: A stale or out-of-order live record after a child finished, or a progress record with status done, makes the same child be announced twice.
non_issues.why_not: Only op 'finished' counts and `announced` blocks repeats (notices.ts:117); a live record re-arms only because the daemon never publishes a stale live status for an ended child: _apply keeps the ended status unless it is a Codex 'started' from the same session (jarvis/v2/subagents.py:519-530), and records are published in lock order (_keep/_flush, :458-485).

non_issues.claim: Marking a notice as a floor 'note' lets turnEnded take it for the turn's reply, or a notice could be posted to Discord.
non_issues.why_not: turnEnded skips note messages when choosing the final reply (floor.ts:95 `!m.note`), pinned by noticesController.test.ts:210. Notices are HUD speech only; 'subagent'/'subagent_event' are outside the Discord mirror's KINDS/TURN_KINDS (subagent_routes_check.py Notices.test_the_discord_mirror_hears_no_sub_agent_record, passes at head: 55 tests OK).

non_issues.claim: The switch lives in localStorage, so it is not synced across windows / not a real setting.
non_issues.why_not: Stated design: per-window convenience, on by default (brief: 'Settings > Voice > Sub-agent notices, per window, on by default'; docs/notes/voice-face.md 'Settings -> Voice -> Sub-agent notices ... per window'), same pattern as read-aloud and duck-browser; storage errors fall back to on and are swallowed (tested in SubagentNoticesSetting.test.ts).
